head: Zoo Boo Is Back at the Detroit Zoo: Merry, Not Scary
sub: Trick-or-treat stations, a kids' DJ and a light-up dance floor open again this weekend
story: Looking for a not-too-spooky night out? The Detroit Zoo's Zoo Boo has returned, and this weekend, Oct. 9 to 11, is the next chance to go. It also runs Oct. 16 to 18 and Oct. 23 to 25, from 3 to 8:30 p.m.

Until 6 p.m. the whole zoo is open. After that, the eastern part, from the main gates to Table 28, lights up as a Halloween area. Kids can trick-or-treat (some stops have allergy-friendly treats), dance on a light-up floor with a kids' DJ, and watch jugglers, aerialists and a talking pumpkin.
Advance tickets start at $21 at dzoo.org/zooboo, and everyone age 2 and older needs one. The zoo calls it "merry, not scary."
head_src: WXYZ 7 Detroit, "Detroit Zoo announces Zoo Boo will return this October," Sept. 17, 2026.
